metadata.title: Broadcom Earnings Today: Stock Looks for a Reset with Third-Quarter Results<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Will Broadcom Earnings Rebuild Confidence in Its AI Growth Story?
Broadcom has the opportunity to reset the narrative with its third-quarter earnings on Wednesday afternoon after a tumultuous three months for the stock. Though Wall Street analysts expect around 70% earnings growth this year and next, the stock is down 30% from its all-time high in June.
